mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tasks (title, description, status, assignee_id, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{status}, #{assigneeId}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
